# Point of Interest Name

**Area:**  
**Type:**  

## Description

Describe the location's purpose, occupants, history, current use, dangers, secrets, and meaningful interactions. Write 900–1000 characters without going over. Keep the text setting-facing rather than explaining how a GM should use it.

## Campaign Introduction

Include this field only when the POI is a campaign starting location. Write the opening narration, immediate situation, visible tension, and initial hook here. Maximum 3000 characters. This field is exempt from the rule requiring text to fall within 100 characters of its limit; use only as much space as the introduction needs. Do not duplicate the introduction or its location-specific discoveries in lore pages.

## Appearance

Describe only the location's visible structure, layout, materials, lighting, sounds, smells, and notable physical details. Write 400–500 characters without going over, and do not repeat the Description or Campaign Introduction.
